headline: XP Lowers Brazil 2027 GDP Growth Projection to 0.3% and Sees USD at 5.50
summary: XP Investimentos reduced Brazil's 2027 GDP growth forecast to 0.3%, citing financial conditions, public debt, and high interest rates, while projecting the exchange rate at 5.50 reais per dollar.
why: Macroeconomic downgrades affect investor confidence and asset allocation strategies in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lowered GDP expectations reflect anticipated economic deceleration.
